notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger or Fire Lord Zuko.
description:
Declare Hellkite Charger and Fire Lord Zuko as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Fire Lord Zuko trigger, adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.name: Fire Lord Zuko
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 7 or greater
